# Hardware matrix

[日本語](hardware-matrix.md) | **English**

Each cell shows a configuration from `profiles/` and how far it was verified.
Cells without a configuration read "not verified". See
[verification results](evidence_en.md) for what the labels mean.

`narration-video-gen plan` or `select` picks the configuration that fits your
machine. Configurations for 12 GiB and below use Q4_K_S models (see
[low-VRAM model selection](low-vram-model-policy_en.md)).
